foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification
purpose: Reconcile apparently different XRP spot ETF flow and holdings figures by universe, method, timestamp, settlement status and source lineage; preserve derivatives and institutional-custody context without converting it into a directional signal.

market_cutoff.note: Web-rendered pages were inspected during this run. Their displayed publisher update/check times are retained separately; no raw HTTP wire bytes or response headers were archived.

xrp_insights.universe: Six US spot XRP ETFs plus the XRP sleeve of BITW
xrp_insights.flow_method: Per-fund day-over-day change in issuer-reported XRP holdings; sum of funds with computed flows. Flow-excluded funds contribute zero to the displayed total.
caveats: Rows marked reconstructed for 2026-03-23 through 2026-03-27, 2026-03-31 through 2026-04-29 and 2026-05-12 use third-party daily flow estimates chained between issuer-reported anchor days.
No XRP spot price snapshot was stored from 2025-12-24 through 2026-04-14; USD values for that interval use a NAV-implied XRP price.
A change in holdings can reflect creations/redemptions, fees, rebalancing or other holdings changes; it is not a direct issuer-reported creations/redemptions series for every row.
The displayed five-day sum is not directly comparable with other providers' different fund universes or partial dates.

methodology_notes: The page states that it uses the published flow series and does not publish fund net assets, holdings or fees.
Its fund share percentages divide cumulative net inflow, not current assets under management.
The page explicitly warns that missing/pending latest-session data is not zero and that a flow print describes prior activity, with basket settlement and hedging lags.
The displayed +8.4M USD is for the last seven sessions spanning 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-06; the 30-session +45.9M USD is a different window.

crypto_keyhole.source_type: secondary aggregator collecting issuer-published holdings files
crypto_keyhole.daily_flow_universe: Four funds with daily issuer files: Bitwise XRP, Franklin Templeton XRPZ, Canary XRPC and 21Shares TOXR

partial_day.reporting_coverage: Three of four daily-collected funds; Franklin Templeton XRPZ had not published the corresponding latest file at the displayed check time.
partial_day.admission: Partial only; not a complete daily total.

exclusions_and_coverage: Grayscale GXRP is shown from a quarter-end SEC filing where available, not in daily flow totals, because automated reads are blocked.
REX-Osprey XRPR is excluded from the daily flow total because its reported direct holdings omit XRP exposure held through other exchange-traded products.
No missing fund values are filled, carried forward or estimated.
Issuer files are checked against shares, XRP per share, NAV and net assets where the issuer provides those fields.
The USD flow series uses the aggregator's own XRP/USD close, which can differ from issuer NAV-based valuations.

caveats: These are reported positions in US-listed ETF shares, not direct XRP wallet balances or proof of XRP purchases by the managers.
13F data is quarter-end and filed up to 45 days later; the value changes with ETF share prices as well as position size.
The aggregator's 13F table is a secondary transcription of SEC Form 13F data.

interpretation_limits: The provider says liquidation coverage is incomplete and reports a lower bound.
The page combines exchange data with a stated 15-minute delay; the displayed update was already about one hour old at this run's reference time.
Positive funding and a long-skewed account ratio describe positioning, not a directional forecast. Crowded positioning can persist or unwind in either direction.
No raw per-exchange response receipts were retained in this web capture.

bny_ripple_c2fo.verified_live_capability: BNY states its Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for eligible institutional clients; BNY is primary reserve custodian for RLUSD and has a custody relationship with Ripple Prime.
planned_or_exploratory: BNY and Ripple intend to enable direct RLUSD minting/redemption through BNY, subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.
BNY and Ripple are exploring tokenized trade finance on XRPL, including a supply-chain-finance initiative with C2FO.
not_established: No XRP customer custody balances or net inflows are disclosed.
No XRP collateral utilization or loan balances are disclosed.
No realized C2FO tokenized receivables volume, XRP settlement throughput or capital deployed is disclosed.
The future mint/redeem and trade-finance plans are not represented as already operational.

reconciliation.apparent_disagreement: XRP Insights reports -812,529 XRP over five settled sessions (Nov 2-6), Alpha Finance reports +$8.4M over seven sessions (Oct 27-Nov 6) and +$45.9M over 30 sessions, while CryptoKeyhole reports -3,338.61 XRP for its latest complete day (Nov 5) and -886,665 XRP for a partial Nov 6 day across three of four daily-collected funds.
reasons: Different fund universes: six spot funds plus BITW, five flow-series funds, and four daily issuer-file funds.
Different measurement methods: issuer-holdings deltas, provider flow series, and partial issuer-file holdings deltas.
Different treatment of missing/pending/excluded funds and reconstructed historical rows.
Different USD valuation sources and publication lags.
XRP Insights and CryptoKeyhole both rely on issuer holdings as upstream data, so their outputs are not independent confirmations even though their collection and validation methods differ.
reconciliation.required_next_step: Acquire issuer source files with publication timestamps and point-in-time versions; normalize a fixed six-spot-fund universe, keep BITW separate, keep XRPR look-through separate, preserve missing values as missing, and calculate only settled creations/redemptions where issuer records support them.

source_independence.dependence_warning: The three ETF aggregators share issuer holdings/flow data as upstream inputs. Their numbers must not be counted as three independent sources for the same claim.
source_independence.raw_source_status: Web page excerpts and URLs were reviewed; raw HTTP wire bytes, headers and independently signed source receipts were not retained.

model_admission.reason: Different universes, unresolved point-in-time file vintages, partial issuer coverage, reconstructed history and secondary aggregator dependencies prevent strict point-in-time normalization.

citations_and_capture.tradradar: Observed lines 5-47 and 54-63 on the page.
